title: Barapullah flyover merges into 2-lane stretch, traffic police seek redesign
description:
The three-lane Barapullah Phase-III flyover is merging with a two-lane stretch of the existing corridor near Sundial Park, while traffic from two other three-lane approaches also converge at the same point, with Delhi Traffic Police urging the junction be redesigned to ease congestion, officials said on Tuesday.
The traffic police has asked the Delhi Public Works Department (PWD) to urgently modify the merger point, where the newly-opened phase-III flyover joins the existing Barapullah corridor, saying the sharp and abrupt design of the junction is aggravating congestion on the busy route.
The Barapullah Phase-III flyover was opened to public last week, but the traffic situation on the new stretch deteriorated soon after opening. By Thursday evening, commuters travelling the nearly 8-km stretch between Safdarjung Hospital and Sarai Kale Khan were taking more than an hour to complete the journey, officials said.
